_readme: hotwords  : fed to Whisper during decoding. ONLY rare, distinctive terms that do not
collide with ordinary English/Chinese. Keep this list short (biasing the
decoder with 200 terms makes quality WORSE, not better).
fix_after : full vocabulary, applied AFTER decoding by conservative fuzzy matching.
ambiguous : deliberately NOT auto-corrected. Left for the LLM step, which can see the
whole conversation and judge from context.
people    : names are the single highest-value hotwords (very rare tokens).
Spellings matter more here than anywhere else - check them.

phonetic : build.py additionally does a metaphone+fuzzy pass. Matches are NEVER replaced, only annotated inline as  word [Canon?]  so the LLM can judge. Once you confirm one, move it into fix_after as an exact variant.

initial_prompt : one short paragraph of context handed to Whisper before decoding. Measured +0.8 WER points and +1 jargon term on real accented speech, free. Keep it under ~200 tokens; Whisper truncates and long prompts start hallucinating.
_layers: This file ships with the program and is REPLACED on every update. Do not edit it.
Your own terms belong in glossary.user.json, in the user data directory
(%LOCALAPPDATA%\MinutesDesk by default). The tool reads base + user merged,
with the user layer winning, so you can override anything here without losing it

ambiguous._note: Never auto-replaced. The LLM decides from context and flags anything unclear.
ambiguous.node: a site/location vs a graph node vs Node.js
ambiguous.Quick: Amazon Quick Suite (the product) vs the adjective 'quick'

_prompt_rule: There is deliberately no initial_prompt. Measured 2026-09-10: a prompt naming meeting facts was emitted verbatim as participant speech, and a style-only prompt written to be safe was ALSO emitted ('Transcribe exactly what is said...' became line 1 of a transcript). Any English sentence in the decoder context can come back out as speech on hard audio. Do not add one back. Jargon goes in hotwords: bare nouns are not sentence-shaped, cannot be copied out, and measurably help.
